# Pfundit

> Disciplined Credit for the Real Economy | Singapore Holding Company

Pfundit is a Singapore holding company (Pfundit Pte. Ltd., ACRA UEN: 202544131H) building a technology-enabled lending business, starting with a proposed RBI-registered NBFC in India. Pfundit focuses on short-tenor, asset-backed financing in the real economy across India, Southeast Asia (SEA), and the GCC.

## Key Facts

- **Entity**: Pfundit Pte. Ltd. (Incorporated in Singapore, 2025, UEN: 202544131H, 14B Stanley Street, Singapore 068733)
- **Indian Subsidiary**: Pfundit Capital Private Limited (CIN: U64910KA2026FTC227353, Prestige Central, 36 Infantry Road, Bengaluru 560001)
- **Regulatory Status**: Singapore HoldCo is an investment holding company (unregulated/not lending). Indian subsidiary proposes to apply to RBI for NBFC-ICC (non-deposit taking, Type II, Base Layer); pre-application stage, not currently registered with RBI, no lending until CoR is granted.
- **Target Geography**: India, Southeast Asia, GCC
- **Lending Focus**: Short-tenor, collateralized real-economy credit (MSME working capital, supply chain assets, mid-market enterprises)
- **Contact**: info@pfundit.com
- **Privacy & DPO**: privacy@pfundit.com · dpo@pfundit.com · security@pfundit.com
